title: Messages
description: Send bulk SMS and e-mail to your taxpayers and keep the ones you write to often in groups. Every message is recorded.
bulk_description: Pick who it goes to first, then write the message. Before sending we show how many taxpayers it reaches, the duplicates dropped and who is skipped.
no_groups_yet: No groups yet. Gather the taxpayers you write to often in a group on the "Groups" tab.
filter_hint: Tax return picks taxpayers with that return in the last 12 months. With both on "All" it goes to every taxpayer of the office.
pick_recent_placeholder: Choose one of your earlier sends
no_recent: You have no bulk sends yet.
list_hint: To pick taxpayers one by one, tick rows in the taxpayer list and press "Bulk message".
no_permission: Sending bulk messages needs the permission to edit taxpayers.
send_again: Write to the same taxpayers again
sms_off: SMS is not enabled for this office. Connect the NetGSM account under Settings > SMS, or send by e-mail.
subject: Subject
body_placeholder: Dear :mukellef, please send your documents for :donem by the 5th. :ofis
variables_hint: Variables are filled for every taxpayer. :tutar and :son_gun stay empty in bulk sends; automation rules fill them.
counter: {{chars}} characters · {{parts}} SMS (at most {{limit}} SMS in bulk sends)
pick_target_first: Pick who it goes to first.
test_mode: Test mode: messages are recorded, not sent.
duplicates_dropped: {{count}} sends were dropped because the phone or e-mail repeated; each address gets one message.
skip_invalid_phone: not a mobile number or invalid
skip_campaign: the name contains a campaign word
groups_description: Gather the taxpayers you write to often in a named list (e.g. "10 VAT-sensitive taxpayers"). In a bulk send just pick the group.
group_delete_description: Only the list is deleted; the taxpayers and message records stay.
group_form_description: Name the group and tick the taxpayers. A group holds at most 500 taxpayers.
group_search: Search by name or tax ID
bulk_dialog_description: The message goes to each taxpayer's phone or e-mail on record. A summary is shown before sending.
bulk_too_many: A bulk message can go to at most 500 taxpayers. Narrow the selection.
